title: OpenAI disbands the team built to assess catastrophic risk - TCR 08/17/26
description:
OpenAI disbanded its preparedness team as it heads toward what could become one of the largest IPOs ever, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called the AI backlash a crisis of trust and endorsed a FINRA-style regulator, and Alibaba's Qwen crossed 3 billion downloads to pass Meta's Llama and Google's Gemma as the world's most-downloaded open model family.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-august-17-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:53 OpenAI disbands its preparedness team
5:21 Alibaba Qwen passes Meta and Google in Hugging Face's 2026 report
8:58 Autonomous research gets measured
12:35 Washington tells partners to pick a side
15:44 Close

This episode covers OpenAI's disbanded preparedness team, Anthropic's crisis-of-trust admission, Alibaba Qwen passing Meta and Google at 3 billion downloads, Inherent Labs' 27B Faraday research agent and Prime Intellect's 153 autonomous runs, the $12 billion PJM grid overcharge, and Washington telling 35 partner nations to pick a side in the AI race.

Two of the largest AI companies conceded they can no longer fully measure their own systems, and three groups outside those companies published the measurements anyway. OpenAI folded away the preparedness team chartered to assess whether catastrophic risks warranted "not yet" before a model ships, while Anthropic's Dario Amodei called the backlash a crisis of trust and admitted the industry has not delivered on its promises. Inherent Labs' 27B Faraday agent beat frontier models at reproducing published research in Inherent's Replica benchmark, and Prime Intellect ran 153 autonomous agents across 18 models, both publishing their traces so the claims can be checked rather than trusted. Underneath runs the download counter: Alibaba's Qwen passed Meta and Google in Hugging Face's 2026 report, while Alibaba says Qwen crossed 3 billion downloads across platforms, average US-lab inference prices fell about 24% between mid-July and mid-August, according to Silicon Data's LLM Token Index, and a frontier-class 27B model now runs in 17GB on a laptop. A six-month reconstruction of PJM's black-box grid model surfaced an estimated $12 billion overcharge onto 66 million ratepayers, and A draft U.S. letter warned 35 nations to choose the American bloc or Beijing's. The thread: the capability everyone is trying to gate is the one thing refusing to stay held.
